Which of these combinations of clinical features is most suggestive of mixed mitral valve disease with a predominance of mitral regurgitation?
Option A: Displaced apex beat; soft first heart sound; pan-systolic murmur; short mid-diastolic murmur
Option B: Irregularly, irregular pulse; displaced apex beat; ejection systolic murmur; short mid-diastolic murmur
Option C: Displaced apex beat; normal first heart sound; pan-systolic murmur; long mid-diastolic murmur
Option D: Tapping apex beat; loud first heart sound; pan-systolic murmur; long mid-diastolic murmur
